original_record.question: Based on this image alone, what is the most probable diagnosis?
original_record.explanation: The presence of inclusion bodies is a classic hallmark of cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection. These inclusions are indicative of viral replication within the cell and can be pathognomonic of CMV when observed under the microscope in the appropriate clinical context.
